body:
I'll start by examining the repository structure, the SKILL.md rules, the reference style file, and the available sources.

I have the sources mapped. Now writing chapter 16.

I need to verify the verbatim excerpts and a couple of line references. Let me inspect the fences I authored.

Completed all three assigned chapters:

- **`16-compose.md`** (192 lines) — wrapper/provider model, `compose_providers` + `PODMAN_COMPOSE_PROVIDER`, `compose_warning_logs` + `PODMAN_COMPOSE_WARNING_LOGS`, socket/`DOCKER_HOST` plumbing, deterministic YAML matrix, docker-compose vs podman-compose caveats, rootless port limits, CI pattern, `kube play` alternative. Includes verbatim `samples/podman-compose.1.md.in:9-16`.
- **`17-kubernetes-and-kube-play.md`** (205 lines) — `play`/`generate`/`apply`/`down`, supported kinds (StatefulSet explicitly absent), full option table including `--replace`, `--build`, `--annotation`, `--log-driver`, `--quiet`, plus documented absence of `--service-container`; PVC/ConfigMap/Secret semantics, idempotent apply, `.kube` Quadlet/auto-update, security table covering `hostPath`, `privileged`, `hostNetwork`, unsupported `seccompProfile` and the Podman seccomp annotation route.
- **`18-systemd-quadlet-and-auto-update.md`** (240 lines) — all unit types and root/rootless search paths, `quadlet list/print/install/rm`, key→flag mapping, `AutoUpdate=registry|local`, health/systemd restart interactions (`HealthOnFailure=`, correction of `HealthcheckOnFailureAction`), legacy `generate systemd` vs Quadlet, `systemd-run`, boot ordering, `daemon-reload` validation workflow, lingering. Verbatim excerpts from all four required samples.

Authoring checks run: all 11 verbatim fences match their cited source ranges exactly; all citation tokens are in range; every fence has an immediate valid header; all chapters end with `## Pitfalls` / `## Sources` and sit within the 120–240 line target. `verify.py` was not run, per assignment.
